sloka: भरतश्च विसञ्ज्ञो ऽभूच्छ्रुत्वा रामस्य भाषितम् ।राज्यं विगर्हयामास राघवं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। ७.१०७.५ ॥
transliteration: bharataśca visañjño 'bhūcchrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam ।rājyaṁ vigarhayāmāsa rāghavaṁ cedamabravīt ।। 7.107.5 ॥

translations.english: Bharata also became unconscious upon hearing Rama's words, and condemning kingship, he spoke these words to Rama.
